in_marathi.name: Minalini
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Mountain of Rows of Jewels
in_marathi.long_meaning: Minalini हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Minalini is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'mini' which means mountain, and 'lini' which means rows of jewels. This name is believed to evoke the image of a beautiful and radiant woman, symbolizing wealth, prosperity, and beauty.
